phase: INS-002B Additive River CRM Contact-Attempt Persistence
objective: Persist provider-neutral insurance contact-attempt execution state durably in the existing River CRM D1 boundary without selecting a telephony vendor, performing transport, executing a production migration, or coupling canonical River identity to provider identifiers.

contactAttemptTable.name: river_crm_contact_attempts
foreignKeys: trigger_event_id -> river_crm_relationship_events.event_id ON DELETE SET NULL
indexes: provider + provider_reference partial when provider_reference is non-null
trigger_event_id partial when trigger_event_id is non-null
rules: lifecycle updates may mutate only execution fields
immutable request identity fields are matched during update
retryable is stored as nullable integer boolean
raw provider payload is not stored

providerEventReceiptTable.name: river_crm_contact_provider_events
providerEventReceiptTable.purpose: Provide durable provider-neutral webhook redelivery deduplication before INS-002F adds a concrete provider webhook.
rules: No raw provider payload is stored.
Provider event identity remains external evidence.
Duplicate provider plus provider_event_id insertion is ignored.
Receipt persistence performs no lifecycle reconciliation in INS-002B.
All attempt rows are reconstructed through createInsuranceContactAttempt.
insertAttempt is insert-only and surfaces duplicate constraint failures.
updateAttempt validates the complete canonical attempt and matches immutable request identity in its WHERE clause.
getAttempt validates the canonical attempt identifier before querying.
listAttemptsForRelationship validates canonical relationship identity and bounds its limit.
recordProviderEventReceipt returns true only for the first durable provider event receipt and false for a duplicate.

tests: migration creates provider event receipt table
migration contains required relationship and trigger-event foreign keys
insertAttempt validates canonical attempt before D1 write
getAttempt maps D1 row through canonical constructor
retryable maps null zero and one correctly
provider event receipt first insert returns true
provider event receipt duplicate returns false
provider event receipt stores no raw payload
acceptanceCriteria: Contact-attempt lifecycle is durable and provider-neutral.
Immutable request identity cannot be silently rewritten by updateAttempt.
Provider-event redelivery can be durably deduplicated later.
No raw provider payload is persisted.
No production D1 resource is mutated.
No provider or network behavior is introduced.
